provenance.generator: Geographic spherical-ray horizon bake + direct per-position SPICE DE421 geometric vectors
provenance.notes: NASA-derived exploration: 25 position-specific 30 km horizons and per-position DE421 geometric ephemeris. Supported heights are separately baked. Ground-observer celestial vectors are reused at height; maximum computed direction approximation 0.00000161 degrees. Terrain sampling and finite range remain limitations. No landing or survival certification.

correctedGeographicBake.selectionMethod: Highest elevation interior source pixel with slope below 6 degrees; exploratory candidate, not official target
correctedGeographicBake.horizonGeometry: exact spherical radial terrain in observer tangent plane
correctedGeographicBake.raySampling: 5 m to 2 km; 25 m from 2 to 30 km

convergence.meaning: Angular interpolation sensitivity, not end-to-end error or confidence interval; hourly timing, raster sampling and finite ray range remain limitations.
